task.title: Contract clause classification (32 clause types)
task.business_story: Legal-ops and procurement teams review incoming supplier, licence and distribution contracts by tagging each clause with its type so risky terms get routed to a lawyer. Every clause of every contract goes through the classifier, so a cheaper model that tags as well as the top one cuts review cost directly.

import os
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(base_url="https://api.tokenfactory.nebius.com/v1", api_key=os.environ["NEBIUS_API_KEY"])

MODEL = 'nvidia/Nemotron-3-Ultra-550b-a55b'
THINKING = True  # Nemotron reasoning; measured with it on
SYSTEM = 'You are helping a legal team review commercial contracts. Classify the contract clause below into exactly one of these clause types and reply with the label only:
governing_law

non_disparagement
covenant_not_to_sue
most_favored_nation
volume_restriction
warranty_duration
post_termination_services

third_party_beneficiary

Reply with the answer only.'
FEW_SHOT = []


def run(text: str) -> str:
    messages = [{"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM}, *FEW_SHOT, {"role": "user", "content": text}]
    r = client.chat.completions.create(
        model=MODEL, messages=messages, temperature=0, max_tokens=4161,
        extra_body={"chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": THINKING}},
    )
    if r.choices[0].finish_reason == "length":
        raise RuntimeError("ran out of tokens before answering")
    return r.choices[0].message.content.strip()
